name: EUR/GBP ATR Breakout - 7-Day Hold
description: Mean-reversion strategy trading EUR/GBP based on ATR breakouts in EUR/USD and GBP/USD. Shorts EUR/GBP when EUR/USD daily range exceeds its 14-day ATR, longs EUR/GBP when GBP/USD daily range exceeds its 14-day ATR. Extended 7-day holding period to capture more mean reversion.
source:
# EUR/GBP ATR Breakout - 7-Day Hold
# Mean reversion strategy fading currency volatility spikes
#
# LOGIC:
# - SHORT EUR/GBP when EUR/USD daily range >= EUR/USD 14-day ATR (EUR volatility spike)
# - LONG EUR/GBP when GBP/USD daily range >= GBP/USD 14-day ATR (GBP volatility spike)
# - Hold positions for exactly 7 trading days
# - Position size inversely proportional to EUR/GBP ATR

# Primary asset data (EUR/GBP)
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# Reference data: EUR/USD
eurusd = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.EURUSD)()
eurusd_high = eurusd.h
eurusd_low = eurusd.l
eurusd_close = eurusd.c

# Reference data: GBP/USD
gbpusd = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.GBPUSD)()
gbpusd_high = gbpusd.h
gbpusd_low = gbpusd.l
gbpusd_close = gbpusd.c

# Calculate daily ranges
eurusd_range = eurusd_high - eurusd_low
gbpusd_range = gbpusd_high - gbpusd_low

# Calculate 14-day ATR for each pair
# ATR needs the data source object, not individual series
# For reference pairs, calculate ATR using the ma of true range
eurusd_tr = eurusd_high - eurusd_low
eurusd_atr = ma(period=14, type=MAType.sma)(eurusd_tr)

gbpusd_tr = gbpusd_high - gbpusd_low
gbpusd_atr = ma(period=14, type=MAType.sma)(gbpusd_tr)

# For EUR/GBP (primary asset), use ATR directly
eurgbp_atr = atr(period=14)()

# Entry signals
# SHORT EUR/GBP when EUR/USD range exceeds its ATR (fade EUR volatility)
short_entry = eurusd_range >= eurusd_atr

# LONG EUR/GBP when GBP/USD range exceeds its ATR (fade GBP volatility)
long_entry = gbpusd_range >= gbpusd_atr

# Execute with 7-day hold periods
long_and_short_zone(hold_long=7, hold_short=7, strict_hold=True)(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Position sizing - inversely proportional to EUR/GBP ATR
# Base weight scaled down when volatility is high
base_weight = 10.0
atr_normalized = eurgbp_atr / close
weight = base_weight / (1 + atr_normalized * 100)

position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weight)

# Event markers for visualization
short_marker = 1.0 if short_entry else 0.0
long_marker = 1.0 if long_entry else 0.0

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Entry Signals",
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Short Entry (EUR/USD Breakout)", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(title="EUR/USD Range", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="EUR/USD ATR", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Long Entry (GBP/USD Breakout)", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="GBP/USD Range", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="GBP/USD ATR", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5)
        ]
    )
)(short_entry, eurusd_range, eurusd_atr, long_entry, gbpusd_range, gbpusd_atr)

# Timeseries visualization - ATR comparisons
timeseries_lines(
    title="EUR/USD: Daily Range vs ATR",
    category="ATR Analysis",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Daily Range", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="14-Day ATR", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(eurusd_range, eurusd_atr)

timeseries_lines(
    title="GBP/USD: Daily Range vs ATR",
    category="ATR Analysis",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Daily Range", color=Color.Emerald),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="14-Day ATR", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(gbpusd_range, gbpusd_atr)

timeseries_lines(
    title="EUR/GBP ATR (Position Sizing)",
    category="ATR Analysis",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="EUR/GBP 14-Day ATR", color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(eurgbp_atr)

timeseries_lines(
    title="Position Weight",
    category="Position Sizing",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Volatility-Adjusted Weight (%)", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=5, title="5%", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=10, title="10%", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(weight)
